sentences.en: The benefits of exercise can be tangibly seen in improved health.
sentences.zh: 锻炼的好处可以实实在在地体现在健康改善上。

sentences.en: She felt her confidence grow tangibly as she made more friends.
sentences.zh: 随着她结交了更多的朋友，她的自信心明显地增强了。

sentences.en: The company's success was tangibly demonstrated by its expanding office space.
sentences.zh: 该公司通过不断扩大办公空间有形地展示了其成功。
